CONTRACT VEHICLE. The proposal states the Sourcewell Member ID #: 76103 and that pricing is "Delivered unit pricing per Palmer Hamilton's Sourcewell Contract #121919-PHL." Every product specification block references RFQ-12126-C7Q4.

LINE 1 - BOOTHS. Six (6.00 Each) Palmer Hamilton BOOTH20-60B2B units at a unit price of 3,395.00 for an extended amount of 20,370.00. Each is a 60" long back-to-back booth assembly that includes a back-to-back frame, fiberglass backs and seats, and a laminated back panel. Distribution is QTY 3 to Cafeteria Area 1 and QTY 3 to Cafeteria Area 2. Tag TG: A1 - Cafeteria.

LINE 2 - RECTANGULAR TABLES. Eight (8.00 Each) Palmer Hamilton ATT293060 units at 702.10 each for an extended amount of 5,616.80. Each is a 30" x 60" rectangle fixed-leg standard-weight Aero T-base table with glides. Options: Base - Metallic Silver (MS); Edge - SmartEdge; Edge Profile - Eased; Edge Color - Black (1); Laminate - Group 1; Laminate Selection - Wilsonart 4879-38 Steel Mesh (839-STE). Distribution is QTY 4 to Cafeteria Area 1 and QTY 4 to Cafeteria Area 2. Tag TG: A2 - Cafeteria.

LINE 3 - PUB-HEIGHT TABLES. Four (4.00 Each) Palmer Hamilton ATX4236RD units at 641.20 each for an extended amount of 2,564.80. Distribution is QTY 2 to Cafeteria Area 1 and QTY 2 to Cafeteria Area 2. Tag TG: A3 - Cafeteria.

LINE 5 - INSTALLATION. One (1.00 Each) line from IE Distribution Services, LLC for Installation at 1,040.00 for an extended amount of 1,040.00. The Palmer Hamilton Installation scope is itemized as (6) back-to-back booths, (8) 30"D x 60"W x 29"H tables, and (4) 36" round x 42"H tables.

TOTALS AND PAYMENT. Order Sub-Total: $29,591.60. TOTAL ORDER: $29,591.60. Required Deposit 50.0%: $14,795.80. The proposal asks the buyer to review the quotation and notify the seller promptly of any corrections, and states that a finance charge of 1-1/2% per month, an annual percentage rate of 18%, will be charged on accounts past due. A signature line is provided for signature, name, title and date.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SALE. Section 1 (Proposals and Orders): all prices quoted by the Seller are valid for 30 days from the date of proposal; the Seller's proposal constitutes an offer and the Buyer's approval constitutes acceptance; if the Buyer submits a purchase order before the Seller issues a proposal, the Seller's proposal is a counteroffer; the Agreement consists solely of the proposal plus these Terms and Conditions and supersedes prior agreements and conflicting terms in any Buyer purchase order; modifications require Seller and manufacturer approval, Express Ship Orders cannot be changed or cancelled, all goods are custom manufactured and cannot be returned, no restocking programs are available, and modifications must be made by signed and dated revised proposal.

Section 2 (Credit Approval and Deposits): all orders are subject to credit approval; a deposit of 50% is required on all orders greater than $5,000.00, with no interest accruing on deposits; orders less than $5,000.00 must be paid in full. Section 3 (Ownership and Risk of Loss): title transfers when the Agreement is entered, after which the Buyer insures against loss; goods received by Seller on Buyer's behalf are held in bailment for the Buyer's sole benefit.

Section 4 (Payment): remaining balances are invoiced upon delivery to the job site or, if Seller installs, following substantial completion; direct manufacturer shipments are invoiced on shipment. Seller may increase prices on notice to reflect unusual or unforeseen cost increases, limited to the increase actually incurred. A monthly service charge of 1.5% (18% A.P.R.) is assessed on unpaid balances, and a service charge of three percent (3%) is added to invoices paid by credit card. Freight and handling, including tariffs, are the Buyer's responsibility and are FOB origin. Sales, use and excise taxes are the Buyer's responsibility, and any tax-exempt certificate must be provided prior to order placement. Goods stored because the Buyer cannot receive them are stored at the Buyer's expense.

Section 5 (Delivery and Installation): contracted delivery and installation occur during normal business hours of 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday through Friday; overtime at the Buyer's request is billed at time-and-a-half for weekdays and double time for weekends and holidays; union tradesmen costs, if required by trade regulations, are billed to the Buyer. Seller receives, inspects, stages and installs, leaves furnishings clean and in working order, removes cartons to the Buyer's waste containers, and leaves the premises broom clean. The Buyer must have an agent on site to accept goods; unsigned acknowledgements result in deemed acceptance "as is." For drop shipments the Buyer inspects, installs and files freight claims. The job site must be clean and clear of obstructions, and the Buyer furnishes electrical current, heating, lighting, trash containers, hoisting or elevator services, and dock and staging space at no charge. A licensed electrician, if required, is contracted and paid by the Buyer. The Buyer is responsible for security of delivered goods. Concealed or damaged packaged goods must be reported within seven (7) business days of receipt, damage revealed on unpackaging within seven (7) days, with photographs of goods, packages and labels required to initiate warranty claims.

Section 6 (Additional Terms): the Seller disclaims all express and implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, quality, capacity and workmanship, while preserving the Buyer's rights against the manufacturer; the Seller is not liable for loss of use, revenue, anticipated profit, or special, indirect, incidental or consequential damages. Resale requires the Buyer to pass through the same warranty limitation. The Seller is not liable for delay from installation site delays, labor disputes, strikes or acts of God. The Buyer may not assign without written consent and must indemnify the Seller except for gross negligence or willful misconduct. If the Buyer fails to pay within ten (10) days after an amount is due, the Seller may accelerate the entire amount, sue for all payments, or repossess the goods without court order. Waiver on one occasion is not a future waiver. Any action by the Buyer must be brought within one year after the cause of action accrues. The Agreement is deemed entered into and performed in substantial part in Oakland County, Michigan, is governed by Michigan law, and the parties submit to the exclusive personal jurisdiction of state or federal courts serving Oakland County, Michigan.
